subject: Plotting intensity value at pixel center in image

messages.author: fa6884457716c3bb
messages.subject: Plotting intensity value at pixel center in image
parts:
Hello,

This may be a strange question, but is there a simple way to show the value of the intensity within the pixel in an image(...) plot as a number ? 

Heath

messages.author: 6033d3c0e7d242fa
messages.subject: Re: Plotting intensity value at pixel center in image
parts:
Hi Heath,

No, there is not simple built-in way of doing that.

The easiest interactive way I can think of would be to plot the image using select(mode="pixel"), then get the coordinates from that, and use text() to plot the intensities. If you already know the coordinates, then just use text().

-Kylie

messages.author: fa6884457716c3bb
messages.subject: Re: Plotting intensity value at pixel center in image
parts:
Ok thanks, the text suggestion worked for I wanted to do.

Just in case others may be interested, I wanted to plot an image where the pixel's intensity was its an index. 

idx = 1:ncol(peakdata)
image(peakdata, idx~x*y, strip=F, colorkey=F, key=F, layout=c(2,1))
image(peakdata, idx~x*y, strip=F, colorkey=F, key=F, xlim=c(90,95), ylim=c(90,95))
text(x= coord(peakdata)[,1], y= coord(peakdata)[,2], labels=idx, cex = 0.5)


Thanks,
Heath
